sentences.text: What happens... if you don't sleep for seven days?
Day one. After twenty-four hours awake, your brain works like you're drunk.
It's hard to focus, you get irritated easily, and your reactions slow down.
Day two. Your body starts forcing itself to sleep.
You can doze off for a few seconds without even noticing.
This is called microsleep, and it's extremely dangerous behind the wheel.
Days three and four. Your brain starts to glitch.
You might see or hear things that aren't really there.
Days five to seven. It gets harder to tell what's real and what's not.
Your thoughts get messy, you become paranoid, and your memory fades.
In nineteen sixty-four, a teenager named Randy Gardner stayed awake for eleven days straight!
He hallucinated so badly, he believed he was a famous football player.
Get seven to nine hours of sleep every night.
What's the longest you've ever stayed awake?
